headline: Nigerian Naira Drops to N1,352 per Dollar on Import Demand and Outflows
summary: The Nigerian naira fell to N1,352 per dollar in official trading as foreign portfolio investors took profits and rising import dollar demand overwhelmed domestic foreign currency supply.
why: Nigeria's foreign exchange liquidity remains pivotal for international corporate repatriation of earnings and domestic inflation trajectory.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: The naira weakened to 1,352 per dollar due to elevated commercial dollar demand and foreign investor outflows.
